limbo.magiccircles.poltergeist.become: Your curse follows you across. You are a poltergeist: doors, buttons, levers and chest lids still answer your touch. [%s] calls the rain; [%s] drags the dead up out of the ground.
limbo.magiccircles.poltergeist.rain: The sky weeps at your call
limbo.magiccircles.poltergeist.rain_here: No sky here will answer you
limbo.magiccircles.poltergeist.skeleton: Something claws its way up at your call
limbo.magiccircles.poltergeist.no_ground: There is no ground beneath you to raise anything from
fairy.magiccircles.dialogue.greeting.0: Redstone! You have brought redstone, haven't you? Our realm has none, and every portal we open drinks it.
fairy.magiccircles.dialogue.greeting.1: Hush - the tree is listening. What will you give for what I have?
fairy.magiccircles.dialogue.greeting.2: Purple chalk is ours alone to make. Pay well, and some of it can be yours.
fairy.magiccircles.dialogue.greeting.3: A wyrm from the deep water? A stone with a heart in it? Such things cost dearly... in redstone.
fairy.magiccircles.dialogue.queen_greeti: I have walked both sides of the veil, child. There is little you could offer me - but redstone opens doors, and I have many doors to open.
The Wellspring gives, and the dark takes. I have made my peace with both. Now - what is it you want?
fairy.magiccircles.dialogue.bargain: Lost one. Your body lies cold and your soul wanders. I can send you back to it - for a price you will pay later, gladly or not.
fairy.magiccircles.trade.refused: She will not deal with one who struck at her
fairy.magiccircles.queen.wrath: <The Fairy Queen> You raise your hand against my people? Then the sky itself will answer you.
fairy.magiccircles.queen.summons: <The Fairy Queen> Lost one... I have a bargain to offer you. Come, speak with me.
fairy.magiccircles.queen.bargain_done: <The Fairy Queen> Go, then. Live - and remember what you owe.
fairy.magiccircles.court.crowned: %s rises to take up the crown. Long live the queen!
fairy.magiccircles.court.fallen: %s has fallen, and returns to the Wellspring beyond the veil. The tree waits for another to rise.

fairy.magiccircles.court.revived: %s breathes life back into the soul that has waited longest at her court.
fairy.magiccircles.queen.banish: <%s> I know what you are. It was your kind that drove my people out of the world above, thousands of years ago. Here it is I who rule - not you, and not any god. You are not welcome in my realm. Begone.
fairy.magiccircles.court.crowned_after: %1$s has returned to the Wellspring. Long live %2$s!
